meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 装上后,当你请 Claude 给 NanoClaw 加新功能或改设置时,它会先问几个问题弄清需求,然后调用对应工具或改好配置,并告诉你怎么验证和重启。
howto.when: 当你提出要添加聊天渠道、更改触发词或添加集成等定制需求时触发。

say.text: 我想把 Telegram 加为输入渠道。
say.note: 会确认渠道归属和隔离级别,再完成配置。

say.text: 帮我改一下这个智能体组的触发规则。
say.note: 会引导你更新该组的触发规则并验证。

say.text: 给某个智能体组加一个 Gmail 工具。

howto.what_en: After install, when you ask Claude to add a feature or change settings in NanoClaw, it asks a few clarifying questions, then invokes the right tool or updates the config, and tells you how to verify and restart.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a new chat channel, change triggers, or add an integration, or make other customizations to NanoClaw.

say_en.text: I want to add Telegram as an input channel.
say_en.note: Claude asks channel and isolation details, then sets up.

say_en.text: Help me change the trigger rules for this agent group.
say_en.note: Walks you through updating the wiring trigger rules.

say_en.text: Add a Gmail tool for a specific agent group.
